verified_contract: The wrapper builds from the separately reviewed AEON development study artifact and keeps the historical MOSAiC v1/v2 payload and 25-row blocked experiment registry intact.

The output is explicitly classified OFFLINE_RESEARCH_MIXED_STUDIES_DEVELOPMENT_ONLY, records no final CAL/TEST evaluation, serves no AEON cached forecast and marks independent final-release review false.
All 22 Windows Python 3.12 wheels must exactly match the previously verified historical offline wheelhouse manifest before they are copied.

Every packaged file except SHA256SUMS is inventoried and byte-hashed; symlinks, missing files, extra files and changed bytes fail verification. The ZIP has fixed member timestamps and an adjacent archive SHA-256 sidecar.
The launcher creates a local Python 3.12 environment offline, verifies packaged bytes before dependency installation, installs only from the bundled wheelhouse and binds the server to 127.0.0.1.
The package includes the five exact independent development-outcome review records and does not redistribute the source acoustic archive.
claims_review: README and metadata consistently label the package development-only and state that CAL and retrospective TEST are not final-evaluated.
Source time zone, publication latency and independent field calibration remain explicitly unverified.
The package makes no species, biomass, catch, fuel, operational-benefit, SOTA or incremental-JEPA claim.
limitations: The temporary archive digest above binds the independently rebuilt commit-419be6c package only. A persistent archive built from a different source commit requires its own byte-level outcome review.
This approval does not cover a later app or package that adds model selection, calibrated intervals or retrospective TEST results.
The launcher assumes uv and a locally available Python 3.12 interpreter; it does not download either dependency.
